text:
Mia: Quick kickoff — we need to wire up AWS/GCP/Azure publisher flows for the new VoltPack trial SKU. Initial ask: IAM role mapping, AMI/VM images, offer metadata (offerId / product SKU), and legal artifacts. Can PartnerOps confirm staging org and creds?
Sam: Yep. We can create the publisher accounts tomorrow AM. Need exact IAM role ARNs and a short terraform output list.
PartnerOps: Staging access is ready — shared 1Password folder `marketplace-pub-staging`. I uploaded: publisher_account_id, staging_role_arn, sso_metadata.xml.
Oliver: From infra side we'll need these terraform outputs in this exact shape: `publisher_account_id`, `delegated_admin`, `kms_key_arn`, `listing_bucket`. Quick script I run will validate. Example:```
# tf output example
publisher_account_id = "123456789012"
delegated_admin = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/marketplace-delegated"
kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"
```
Priya: Legal needs: final EULA (redlined ok), DPA, export-control statement, and the marketing blurb for the public listing. Also confirm telemetry/log retention and whether telemetry is aggregated/anonymized.
Mia: For assets: SVG logo + 1200x600 PNG, short description (<=250 chars), long description (<=1500 chars), allowed regions. We'll default to US/EU/APAC.
Sam: Pricing/tier question — do we want a 14-day free trial SKU with tiered seat pricing or a fixed monthly trial? I recommend 14-day trial + metered usage.
Priya: 14-day trial ok. Telemetry: allowed if anonymized; must include opt-out and PII never sent. Add that to the listing legal notes.
Oliver: One more infra note: for Azure we need the publisher tenant ID and an ARM template snippet. GCP needs a disk image/gcloud-ready tarball. PartnerOps, can you confirm AMI / image uploads?
PartnerOps: AMI for AWS uploaded to `redwood-marketplace-staging` account, snapshot id `snap-0a1b2c3d`. GCP image named `voltpack-staging-2026-03-15`. Azure VHD uploaded to storage account `rpmarketplaceimages`. I posted links in 1Password.
Mia: Great. Action items: 1) Oliver — post tf outputs + ARM/GCP image pointers by EOD today. 2) Priya — drop EULA + DPA draft by Thu. 3) PartnerOps — confirm offer metadata (offerId, publisher display name, SKU code) and upload marketing assets by Fri. 4) Sam — prepare listing manifest template (JSON) for marketplace upload. We'll attempt a staging publish next Wed. :rocket:
Sam: I can start the manifest template now. Quick question: do we pin quantization/instance types in the listing metadata or leave flexible?
Oliver: Leave flexible but recommend a default instance family and a note about recommended GPU. We can include a `recommended_instance` field.
Priya: Also note any compliance statements: SOC2 status, data residency options in the listing.
PartnerOps: Confirmed. I'll also open a publisher support ticket with AWS to pre-warm the SKU entitlement mapping.
DeployBot: staging-publish job queued for 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC (job id: jp-7788).
Mia: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a pre-publish dry run. If anything blocks the EOD deliverables, ping here with @Mia. :thumbsup:
Oliver: ACK. Posting tf outputs to 1Password + this thread root when done.
Priya: Will upload legal drafts to the shared drive and ping here.
PartnerOps: Uploaded offer metadata and image links to 1Password. All set from my side.
Sam: Draft manifest ready and attached to the 1Password folder under `marketplace-manifests/voltpack.json`. I'll iterate based on infra/legal feedback.
Mia: Closing loop — next check-in Mon 10:00 PT. Thanks!
